name: cordova-to-capacitor
description: Migrates an Apache Cordova, PhoneGap, or Ionic-Cordova app to Capacitor. Use when the project has config.xml, a platforms/ or plugins/ folder, cordova-* or phonegap-* dependencies, @awesome-cordova-plugins or @ionic-native wrappers, deviceready listeners, or cordova.plugins.* calls, and the user wants Capacitor native projects, Capacitor/Capgo plugin replacements, config.xml preference migration, and preserved localStorage/IndexedDB data (iosScheme/androidScheme). Covers keeping Cordova plugins
author: Cap-go
